title: Premium BBQ & Smash Burger Kit – Complete Stainless Steel Set with Accessories & Storage Bag
descriptionHtml:
This is not just another BBQ tool set, it is the dream kit for anyone who loves to barbecue, cook smash burgers and show off at the flat-top griddle. With a full 25 stainless steel pieces you get everything you need to turn your BBQ or our stainless steel flat-top griddle into a full-scale outdoor pro kitchen.

We are not talking about a few basic tools here. This is a well-thought-out kit with gear that is built to last, designed to deliver the best possible results and packed in a hard-wearing bag so you can take it anywhere – to the BBQ night, the campsite or the holiday house.

Why our customers love this kit:

  • Everything you need in one pack – spatulas, scrapers, bottles, spice shakers, burger press, ring moulds, splatter guard, tongs, basting brush and much more.

  • Built for smash burgers – the heavy cast iron burger press and the rings for eggs or mini burgers make it easy to nail that perfect restaurant feel at home.

  • Pair it with our griddle – together, this set becomes the ultimate gift for any BBQ fanatic. The flat-top griddle gives you even heat distribution, and with this kit you can cook everything from smash burgers and quesadillas to veggies and fish.

  • Pro quality at home – made from stainless steel with timber and rubber details for the best feel and durability.

  • Perfect as a gift – an unforgettable present for the son, husband or mate who loves cooking outdoors. A set that oozes quality, passion and BBQ joy.

Includes, among other things:

  • 4 different spatulas for different jobs

  • Scrapers and cleaning tools for easy clean-up

  • Cast iron burger press for smash burgers with the perfect crust

  • Stainless steel melting dome for steam-melting cheese or quick cooking

  • Egg rings and burger moulds for perfect shapes

  • Spice shakers and bottles for sauces and oil

  • Hard-wearing storage bag for every piece

In short:

This set turns every BBQ night into an experience. It is the difference between just “chucking something on the barbie” and truly creating restaurant quality at home on the deck.

When you bring out this kit, you will feel the same pride a chef feels in their kitchen. It is clever, practical, robust and above all fun to use.

👉 For $209.95 AUD you are not just getting a kit of tools. You are getting a complete experience, memories for life and the best gear you can give yourself, your son or your husband who loves to barbecue and experiment in the kitchen.

title: The Master — Grates Gleaming. Beer Cold.
descriptionHtml:
Your guests arrive in an hour.

You do everything right. Meat from a proper butcher. The thermometer. The rest. And still it never turns out quite like it does at a restaurant, and the grates look the way they always do: shiny on top, black down in the grooves.

You grab the wire brush. Scrub. Twenty minutes later it looks clean.

It isn't. A wire brush only reaches the surface. The grease down in the grooves stays put, and tonight it heats up again, smokes, and flavours the meat you're serving.

And that's not even the most expensive problem. Burnt-on grease is corrosive. It slowly breaks down the metal from underneath. A BBQ worth thousands should last fifteen years. With dirty grates it might last seven.

And the wire brush? In February 2026, Weber recalled 3.2 million wire brushes in the US. "A dangerous design flaw," said the American safety authority. Six weeks later, Nexgrill pulled back another 10.2 million. Here, they're still sitting on the shelves. At the big hardware chains. Right next to your Weber.

The Master gets your grates properly clean. In sixty seconds.

An electric rotating head does the job for you, all the way around each bar and down into the grooves, where a wire brush never reaches. The coarse head has a locking mechanism: no bristles can come loose. The polishing head has no metal at all. You hold the handle, press the button and go. Done before your beer goes warm.

FEATURES

Two heads, zero compromises — coarse head with locking mechanism (physically impossible to drop bristles into your food) + polishing head with no metal at all

60 seconds — from "looks clean" to properly clean, right down in the grooves

Protects your grates instead of wearing them down — the difference between a BBQ that lasts seven years and one that lasts fifteen

Cordless & rechargeable — 2600 mAh battery, good for 4–6 cleans per charge

Fits all common BBQs — Weber Spirit, Genesis & Q, Napoleon Rogue & Prestige, Broil King Regal and many more.

Lifetime warranty. If it breaks, you get a new one. Full stop.

And 30-day change-of-mind returns, no questions, no process. Try The Master at home on your own BBQ. If it doesn't deliver: full refund. That's our promise. The BBQ Clinic is a Swedish company: you get exactly what you see in the picture, we answer when you get in touch, and we ship straight away.

You've spent thousands on your BBQ. Fifteen years or seven — it's decided in the sixty seconds after every cook.
